fit: contain, uncropped, integer nearest-neighbour upscale, centered
notes: The original is a 444x282, 16-colour GIF87a. A fractional LANCZOS fit (the 3.319x that would fill the 1680x936 safe area) would blur one-pixel window borders and the 6px bitmap UI font, so the framing uses an exact 3x nearest-neighbour upscale to 1332x846 instead. Every source pixel becomes a 3x3 block, so no detail is invented and the transform is exactly reversible: taking every third pixel restores the original raster bit for bit (verified in build_frame.py). The image is uncropped. The dark neutral matte is an authored production choice, not part of the source.
